substeps.caption: AIR vents the chamber; the drawer slides out with the stage on its inside face.
A polished, mounted sample (25 mm) goes onto the stage.
Drawer in, EVAC: about three minutes to vacuum. The EDS detector is built in, its analyser beside. EBSD (left) is a proposal: no TM4000 option exists, and it needs a 70 degree pre-tilted holder.
